ticks.note: Tick 1: `ring` is `{1, 2, 3}`. The self-loop is delayed.

`ring = {ring[1], ring[2], ring[0]}` runs as `ring[0] = ring[1]; ring[1] = ring[2]; ring[2] = ring[0]`, in that order. By the time `ring[2]` is assigned, `ring[0]` is already 2, so the result is `{2, 3, 2}`: the 1 is lost.
And back to `{2, 3, 2}`. The array never rotates.
